greenhouse--noun.def: A glass building where plants are grown.

hardship--noun.def: A difficult situation, especially without money.

lovingly--adv.def: In a way that shows deep affection.

tasteless--adj.def: Having no flavour, or showing bad judgement.

emphasize--verb.def: To say strongly that something is important.
emphasize--verb.ex: He emphasized the need for care.

climber--noun.def: A person who climbs mountains or rocks.
climber--noun.ex: The climber rested on a ledge.

recycled--adj.def: Made from material that was used before.

nutritious--adj.def: Containing what the body needs to stay healthy.

purify--verb.def: To remove dirt or harmful things from something.

mislead--verb.def: To make someone believe something untrue.

timely--adj.def: Happening at exactly the right moment.

similarity--noun.def: The state of being alike in some way.

next-door--adj.def: Living or being in the house beside yours.

revise--verb.def: To change a text, or to study again before an exam.

graph--noun.def: A drawing that shows how numbers relate.
graph--noun.ex: The graph shows a clear rise.

guitarist--noun.def: A person who plays the guitar.

humid--adj.def: With a lot of water in the air.
humid--adj.ex: Summers here are hot and humid.

barman--noun.def: A man who serves drinks in a bar.

cv--noun.def: A document listing your education and work history.
cv--noun.ex: Send your cv with the letter.

hearted--adj.def: Used after a word to describe someone's nature.
hearted--adj.ex: She is a kind hearted woman.

noticeable--adj.def: Easy to see or to notice.

checkout--noun.def: The place where you pay in a shop.
checkout--noun.ex: The queue at checkout was long.

deficiency--noun.def: A lack of something the body or a system needs.

advert--noun.def: A short advertisement, in British English.
advert--noun.ex: I saw the advert in a magazine.

warranty--noun.def: A written promise to repair a product if it fails.

indirectly--adv.def: Not in a direct way, through something else.

intermission--noun.def: A short break in a play or a concert.
intermission--noun.ex: We bought tea at the intermission.

usage--noun.def: The way words are used, or how much is used.

retrospect--noun.def: Thinking about the past with present knowledge.

fondness--noun.def: A feeling of liking someone or something.
fondness--noun.ex: He has a fondness for old films.

complement--noun.def: Something that goes well with another thing.
complement--noun.ex: The sauce is a fine complement.

flunk--verb.def: To fail a test, in American informal English.

participant--noun.def: A person who takes part in an activity.

overwhelm--verb.def: To affect someone so strongly they cannot cope.

constitute--verb.def: To form or be the parts of something.

nationalist--noun.def: A person who strongly supports their own nation.
nationalist--noun.ex: The nationalist gave a long speech.

storyteller--noun.def: A person who tells stories well.

illuminate--verb.def: To give light to a place, or to make something clear.

questionnaire--noun.def: A set of written questions used to collect information.

anxiously--adv.def: In a worried and nervous way.
anxiously--adv.ex: She waited anxiously by the phone.

snowstorm--noun.def: A storm with strong wind and heavy snow.

simplify--verb.def: To make something easier to do or understand.

systematic--adj.def: Done according to a careful plan.

viewpoint--noun.def: A way of thinking about a subject.

rainfall--noun.def: The amount of rain that falls in a place.

furnish--verb.def: To put furniture in a room, or to supply something.

northwestern--adj.def: In or from the north-west part of a place.

ecological--adj.def: Relating to living things and their environment.

skyscraper--noun.def: A very tall building in a city.
skyscraper--noun.exTr: Şehir merkezinde yeni bir gökdelen açıldı.

unfairly--adv.def: In a way that is not right or equal.

revision--noun.def: A change to a text, or study before an exam.

lessen--verb.def: To make something smaller or weaker.

carelessness--noun.def: The fault of not paying enough attention.

daze--noun.def: A confused state in which you cannot think clearly.
daze--noun.ex: He walked out in a daze.

warmly--adv.def: In a friendly way, or with warm clothes.

piety--noun.def: Strong respect for God and religious duty.
piety--noun.ex: He was known for his piety.

takeaway--noun.def: A meal bought to eat at home, in British English.

carelessly--adv.ex: He carelessly left the tap running.

shadowy--adj.def: Dark and full of shadows, or hard to know about.
shadowy--adj.ex: A shadowy figure crossed the yard.

pleasantly--adv.def: In a way that is agreeable.

curiously--adv.def: In a way that shows interest, or strangely.

farmland--noun.def: Land used for growing crops or keeping animals.

photocopy--noun.def: A copy of a document made by a machine.
photocopy--noun.ex: Make a photocopy of your passport.

rudely--adv.def: In a way that is not polite.

restrict--verb.def: To limit what someone can do or have.
restrict--verb.ex: They restricted parking on this street.

enthusiast--noun.def: A person who is very interested in something.

windscreen--noun.def: The glass at the front of a car, in British English.

well-dressed--adj.exTr: İyi giyimli bir adam dışarıda bekliyordu.

vividly--adv.def: In a way that creates a clear strong picture.

seawater--noun.def: The salty water of the sea.
seawater--noun.exTr: Deniz suyu metale hızla zarar verir.

sandal--noun.def: A light open shoe worn in warm weather.
sandal--noun.ex: One sandal broke on the path.

goalkeeper--noun.def: The player who defends the goal.

columnist--noun.def: A writer with a regular article in a newspaper.

geographical--adj.def: Relating to the features of the earth.
